changes.evidence: X-Men Movies wiki: the Recruiter 'was a high-ranking member of Weapon X whose job was recruit those who suffered from terminal illnesses into the program'; 'hired by Ajax to bring in terminally ill people to experiment on for Weapon X'. Infobox affiliation: Weapon X (revised timeline), The Workshop. That is his role in both Deadpool steps (he recruits Wade, then gives up Ajax and is killed). The wiki's Weapon X page lists Ajax as its revised-timeline leader. Medium, not high, because the film itself calls it only 'a very secret organization' (the Workshop is Ajax's facility, and the tracker already uses it as a place).

Marvel Database (Earth-92131): affiliation Maggia. After his cloning work was banned he 'sought work underground'. At the end of the Hydro-Man clone story (the record's episode 60) he takes a scrap of Spider-Man's suit and 'called his current employer, Silvermane, to repair his lab'. owner_calls.question: Lia co-runs Andre Deschaine's New Orleans sex-trafficking ring in Cloak & Dagger S2. The ring has no on-screen name. This is the same question already asked for Deschaine (T:pr-st-andre-deschaine). Add the ring as a group for both, and if so under what name?
options: Add a new group for Lia and Deschaine (e.g. 'Viking Motel Sex Traffic Ring', the wiki's name) from the start, with no departure; she is jailed at the end

She partnered with him to run the support group, kept watch on the girls at the Viking Motel, and tasered Tandy 'putting her into the trafficking ring'. owner_calls.question: Dr. Vance is one of the vampires' human familiars in Blade: Trinity. He has Blade declared psychotic so the authorities hand him over to the Talos vampires. Does a familiar count as a member of The House of Talos? This is the same question as Chief Martin Vreede (T:pr-martin-vreede) and Krieger.
options: No change (a human working for the vampires, not a member)
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia plot: 'The vampires' familiars have arranged for the authorities to turn Blade over to them'. John Michael Higgins plays Dr. Edgar Vance. The Marvel Database has no page for the film character (Edgar Vance (Earth-26320) is a red link). Its only page is the video-game Vance (Earth-41269), whom Drake impersonates, and it lists no affiliation.

owner_calls.question: In X-Men '97 (episode 14) Candra is a member of the pharaoh Rama-Tut's court in ancient Egypt until he abandons her. Count the court as a group, a royal government? And should her later role as the X-Ternal, power broker between the New Orleans Thieves and Assassins Guilds, count as membership? I read that role as outside both guilds.
options: [["Rama-Tut's court", "X-Men '97"], ["Independent", "X-Men '97"]] (a new name; the wiki says 'a member of Egyptian Pharaoh Rama-Tut's court')
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database (Earth-92131): 'Candra was a member of Egyptian Phoraoh Rama-Tut's court in 3,000 B.C.E.'; 'her master escaped through time in a craft'. As the X-Ternal she 'brokered power between the guilds' as 'a neutral entity' for tribute, and nearly wipes out the Thieves Guild. The infobox lists Thieves Guild and Externals, but the show never presents her as a guild member, and the Externals never appear. The Rama-Tut record (T:fox-anim-rama-tut) has no groups either.
